headline: Indian IT services showed mixed revenue growth with AI driving outsized gains for a few firms.
summary: Coforge posted a 53.6% YoY revenue surge, the strongest among peers, while Infosys grew only 1.5% and trimmed its FY27 guidance. Most companies reported double‑digit top‑line growth, but profit margins varied, with HCLTech posting a 21% profit jump on AI contracts. Guidance was cut by Infosys and introduced by HCLTech and Wipro, indicating cautious outlook despite solid demand. AI‑related deals were highlighted across the sector, though only a few disclosed specific AI revenue figures.

themes.title: AI‑led growth
themes.detail: Several firms cited AI revenue or AI‑driven deals as key contributors to top‑line growth, notably HCLTech ($219 m AI revenue) and Mphasis (66% AI‑led contracts).

themes.title: Margin pressure and guidance cuts
themes.detail: Infosys cut FY27 revenue guidance to 1‑2% and its operating margin slipped, while other peers kept or raised guidance but face modest margin expansion.

themes.title: Strong mid‑tier performance
themes.detail: Mid‑tier players like Coforge, LTM and Tech Mahindra delivered double‑digit revenue growth, outpacing larger peers.
